title: FIPS gate failures in write/read/set_iv/gen_iv/finalize/reset logged at pr_debug only
description: fd.c:409-415 (write), 570-575 (read), 840-844 (set_iv), 889-893 (gen_iv), 1375-1380 (finalize), 1448-1453 (reset): FIPS gate failures in these paths use pr_debug. In production kernels without CONFIG_DYNAMIC_DEBUG, pr_debug is compiled out entirely. A caller receives -EACCES with zero dmesg evidence. Only ioctl_init FIPS gate failure (fd.c:759) uses pr_err. Consequence: in a deployment where the wolfcrypt module goes FIPS-degraded mid-session, a caller sees write() return -EACCES with no kernel log to explain why. Support engineers will be handed a bug report with no kernel-side evidence. Fix: change FIPS gate failure logs in write/read/set_iv/gen_iv/finalize/reset to pr_err_ratelimited to match ioctl_init behavior.
